acceptance: Only enumerated budget-v1 calculations and accounting fixtures; no network, market, dispatch or launch acceptance

findings.title: Сертификат относится к перечисленному набору продуктов
findings.mechanism: 224 exported inequalities cover all source enumerated products, including zero sales. They are not a certificate for arbitrary newly priced products. Eight additional time-valid UFA8 connections per scenario are outside the detour-filtered universe; multi-day and longer products have no defined through fares here.

independent_repro.observed: 160 local plus 64 transfer inequalities, all feasible; four zero-sale products retained. Temporal graph: direct0/0, UFA4=8, UFA8=32, of which24 satisfy the detour rule on independently pinned catchments coordinates. Exact match to exported product IDs.

findings.smallest_fix: При переносе указать enumerated dated product universe и fixed fare/cost/capacity. Для иного продукта задать цену и заново проверить dual. Авторский readout:30 уже содержит это ограничение; исходный код менять не требуется.
findings.scoped_impact: All eight verified bounds remain valid. No arbitrary-network impossibility, market optimum, or operating payload acceptance. Canonical author stage11 coordinates are not in the frozen methods package; independent geometry is a diagnostic cross-check.

findings.title: Cash peak зависит от дискретности и порядка платежей
findings.mechanism: The 1M funding figure uses cumulative net cash at period boundaries. Within-period payment order is not represented. Launch is expensed immediately; operating payments/receipts coincide with accrual recognition only by fixture assumption; a refundable deposit is an asset.
findings.smallest_fix: При переносе назвать 1M пиком по границам модельных периодов или указать одновременное netting; для реального peak получить даты и порядок платежей. Сохранить явную accrual policy.
findings.scoped_impact: No change to fixture profit, final cash, deposit accounting or author period-boundary arithmetic. Not a forecast of company's financing requirement.

findings.title: Разности бюджетов не выбирают сеть кейса
findings.mechanism: UFA4 has four rays versus eight pairs in the comparison alternatives. Allocated working-plus-reserve tails are 2/3/3/5. A common incremental F and a genuinely additional UFA base B are scenario choices; retaining a sunk reserve does not create new cash cost. Actual F/B/O stay NULL.
findings.smallest_fix: Сохранить условия сравнения, различие объёма программ, неизвестные дополнительные расходы и included_in. Не объявлять UFA4 финальным победителем 8–12 маршрутов или меньший убыток основанием запуска.
findings.scoped_impact: No numerical defect found. Affine boundaries are usable in appendix as conditional economics. Empirical costs, actual donor, normative objective and case-network choice require separate decisions.
